title: Ride Comfort and Driving Ease
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly describe the F70's ride as comfortable and easy to live with, while a smaller set say the ride feels too firm for comfort and many short fragments mention ride comfort without a clear opinion.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the overall ride comfort and sometimes add that the car drives well.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the ride is not comfortable or is too firm for normal comfort driving.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention ride comfort but do not provide enough detail to tell whether the opinion is favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: The sample examples are heavily skewed toward short, repetitive statements about comfort, so concrete subthemes beyond general ride comfort are limited.
Mixed and neutral sentiments are absent in the supplied examples, which limits nuance.
The selected fragments are a stratified sample and are not representative estimates of all reviews in the topic.
